title: Idempotency boundary
context: A request identity must be retained long enough to prevent duplicate side effects.

title: Pagination contract
context: Existing consumers depend on stable ordering and continuation behavior.

title: Boundary ownership
context: A component boundary should have one explicit owner for state transitions.

title: Independent deployment
context: Deployment independence introduces compatibility and observability obligations.

title: Authorization trust boundary
context: Authentication establishes identity; authorization must check resource and action scope.

title: Refresh token handling
context: Rotation and revocation reduce replay exposure and require auditable state.

title: Traceable acceptance
context: Each requirement should map to an observable verification statement.

title: Scope ambiguity
context: Unresolved ambiguity should be recorded rather than silently interpreted.

title: Service objectives
context: Objectives need a population, measurement window, and threshold.

title: Capacity evidence
context: Capacity claims require workload assumptions and repeatable measurements.

title: Decision alternatives
context: A decision record preserves rejected alternatives and decision constraints.

title: Decision scope
context: Implementation details do not always require an architectural decision record.

title: Risk ownership
context: A risk is actionable when impact, likelihood, mitigation, and owner are explicit.

title: Evidence priority
context: High-priority risks should identify the evidence needed to reduce uncertainty.

title: Causal distinction
context: A symptom is an observed effect and is not itself a root cause.

title: Incident evidence
context: Reproduction steps and timestamps support causal analysis without asserting a cause.

title: Compatibility window
context: Upgrades should preserve supported interfaces or declare migration steps.

title: Regression boundary
context: Maintenance changes need checks around preserved behavior and failure modes.

title: Unrelated context
context: Context without a traceable relationship to the task is not decision evidence.

title: Distraction control
context: Irrelevant material should remain available for audit but excluded from task influence.
